objective: Complete the NACA 0012 ladders on the TMR-distributed grids: 225x65 and 449x129 at alpha 10, then full ladders at alpha 0 and 15, with observed order and Richardson values against the published finest-grid results
rationale: The conversion pipeline is proven and the 113x33 rung at alpha 10 converged flat in 95 seconds, but the finer rungs sustain a wake-driven force oscillation under steady second-order incompressible solves (isolated by scheme substitution); the ladder needs either a time-accurate solve reporting averaged coefficients with an envelope, or a quantified dissipation study, before any comparison is claimed
citations: NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource: NACA 0012 validation case and distributed grids (turbmodels.larc.nasa.gov)
expected_knowledge_gain: First lifting-body ladder; whether the verification discipline holds when pressure drag and lift dominate
launch_prompt: Complete the NACA 0012 ladders on the TMR-distributed grids using a time-accurate approach: pimpleFoam (or simpleFoam with a documented stabilization whose effect is quantified on the coarse rung), coefficients reported as a converged mean with a stated envelope, STOP file honored before every launch, and no agreement claim beyond what the envelope supports. Start from demo-output/website/tmr/naca0012_status.json.
